en.text: Leila had only one choice: cross the bridge before sunset. The winds were growing stronger, and the ground was trembling beneath her feet. But she refused to turn back.
en.description: young adult male with a baritone voice, funny character in an anime story, clear and energetic, friendly

ar.text: لم يكن أمام ليلى سوى خيار واحد: عبور الجسر قبل غروب الشمس. الرياح تزداد قوة، والأرض تهتز تحت قدميها، لكنها لم تتراجع.
ar.description: A warm, youthful, masculine voice with a charismatic, adventurous, and confident personality. Use an expressive, natural delivery with clear articulation and a relaxed, engaging rhythm. Give the character a sense of courage and determination, with a friendly warmth and a subtle hint of humor.
